ConnectionPanel.crsfTelemetryFromAnExpresslrsBackpack: CRSF telemetry from an ExpressLRS backpack
ConnectionPanel.theTelemetryAnExpresslrsTransmitterBroad: The telemetry an ExpressLRS transmitter broadcasts over WiFi. Set Telemetry Mode to WiFi in the ELRS Lua script and join the backpack network, then listen here on port 14550. Works behind any CRSF receiver, INAV included, with nothing changed on the aircraft.
ConnectionPanel.readOnlyPositionAttitudeAltitudeBattery: Read-only: position, attitude, altitude, battery, flight mode and link quality. No missions, parameters, mode changes or commands, because the link only goes one way.
ConnectionPanel.forATwoWayLinkSwitch: For a two-way link, switch the ELRS Link Mode to MAVLink and connect with the MAVLink option instead. That needs an ESP-based transmitter on ELRS 3.5 or newer (backpack 1.5+), a fast packet rate, and INAV 8+ with the receiver UART set to MAVLink at 460800 (Receiver: SERIAL, protocol MAVLINK). INAV is still configured over USB either way.
ConnectionPanel.acceptsPassphrasesBase64KeysFromMission: Accepts passphrases, base64 keys (from Mission Planner), or hex keys. All keys are tried automatically on connect.

ConnectionPanel.mirrorsThisLinkSRawMavlink: Mirrors this link's raw MAVLink to other devices over UDP and relays their commands back. Any UDP peer that can reach this port is picked up automatically once it sends a heartbeat - a phone on the same WiFi, or one with no network at all, bridged in over USB - or enter its address below.

RadioSetupWizard.radiosBuiltIntoTheHandsetE: Radios built into the handset (e.g. TX16S internal) have no USB - they stream over WiFi instead. Enable Backpack WiFi from the ELRS menu on the handset, then either join this computer to the "ExpressLRS TX Backpack" network (password: expresslrs) or put the backpack on your home WiFi. Note: WiFi streaming only works once the radio link is already in MAVLink mode - switching the mode itself needs USB or the handset menu.
RadioSetupWizard.thisModuleRunsElrs40: This module runs ELRS 4.0.0, which corrupts stick positions in MAVLink mode. Update it (and the receiver) to 4.0.1 or newer before operating with sticks.

RadioSetupWizard.theRadioRefusesThisChangeWhile: The radio refuses this change while its receiver is linked. Unpower the vehicle completely - battery out AND USB cable unplugged. You can also press Start now and unpower the vehicle while ArduDeck keeps retrying.
